recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中大量嗜酸性球系細胞：成熟雙葉嗜酸性球、含橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性骨髓球與後骨髓球，偶見顆粒較少或核分葉異常者，嗜酸性系明顯增加，符合嗜酸性球增多症候群的骨髓。
features: Marked increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes)
Cytoplasm filled with orange-red granules; some precursors with mixed dark purple granules
Mature eosinophils with bilobed or ring-like segmented nuclei
Occasional eosinophils with sparser granulation or irregular nuclear lobation
Scattered neutrophils, normoblasts and small lymphocytes; free granules in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of eosinophilic lineage cells at all stages of maturation, including eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes packed with orange-red granules and mature bilobed eosinophils. Occasional eosinophils show sparser granulation or irregular nuclear segmentation, a nonspecific finding. Neutrophils, normoblasts and small lymphocytes are present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings indicate marked eosinophilic hyperplasia, consistent with hypereosinophilic syndrome once reactive and clonal eosinophilic neoplasms have been excluded.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRB or FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These clonal eosinophilic neoplasms are morphologically similar and are separated by cytogenetics/FISH showing 5q32 or 8p11 rearrangement.
In lymphocyte-variant HES the eosinophils are reactive to a clonal aberrant T-cell population (e.g. CD3-/CD4+) detectable by flow cytometry.
CML shows neutrophilic predominance with basophilia and a myelocyte bulge and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
